title: Minecraft Adventures hub
brief: A premium, accessible Minecraft-like choice interface for three Code.org adventures, ordered by the user's didactic difficulty assessment.

artboards.title: Expedition trail
artboards.tradeoff: Clear guided progression; less exploratory freedom

artboards.title: World select
artboards.tradeoff: Strong visual choice and concept scan; taller cards on mobile

artboards.title: Block map
artboards.tradeoff: Most game-like; map illustration adds visual density
